recentItems.description:
Sunny Sands Estates – KBP DEVELOPERS 

Key Highlights

* 📍 Location: Parnasala, Machilipatnam
    * Located on NH-65 (Hyderabad–Machilipatnam Road)
    *  Connected to 3 major highway corridors:
    * NH-65
    * Mucherla–Amaravati Greenfield Highway
    * Ongole–Kattipudi Highway

*Existing 4-lane road, with approval for 6-lane expansion
*  Total Project: 28 Acres

 *  Phase 1: 21 Acres
 *  Total Plots: 281
 * 278 Residential Plots
 * 3 Commercial Plots

Plots Size : East facing starts from 183 sq yards

West starts from 156 yards
Price : 13,000 per sq yard

* 📍 Machilipatnam: Approximately 8 km
*  Located in the vicinity of the developing Machilipatnam Port

*  Proposed Mucherla–Amaravati Greenfield Highway provides improved regional connectivity
*  Better connectivity towards Telangana and Amaravati
*  Water facility provided
*  Underground drainage system
*  Underground electrical cabling
*  40-feet CC roads
*  Green spaces and landscaping
*  2 dedicated parks for children and adults
*  Open gym
*Yoga pavilion
*Shuttle court
*Cricket practice nets
*Compound wall
*  Grand entrance arch
*Planned with professional architects and landscape architects
